scripts.build: node ./scripts/run-deno.mjs task build:release && wxt build && node ./scripts/sync-wxt-bootstrap.mjs
scripts.check: wxt prepare && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.wxt.json
scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.js wxt.config.ts vitest.config.ts entrypoints/**/*.ts scripts/run-deno.mjs scripts/sync-wxt-bootstrap.mjs tests/**/*.test.js tests/**/*.ts tests/shims/*.js vitest-tests/**/*.test.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm test && rm -rf .output && node ./scripts/run-deno.mjs task verify
scripts.legacy:verify: rm -rf .output && node ./scripts/run-deno.mjs task check && node ./scripts/run-deno.mjs task test && node ./scripts/run-deno.mjs task build:release
